---
title: "What does the 3 mm glider look like?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

ENTRY_CEILING = 60.0
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0
PROBE_POOL = 120.0
PROBE_SPENT = 25.9

res = optimize_glider_3mm(verbose=False)
glider = make_glider_3mm(res['c_root'], res['taper'], res['cg_x'])
```

**Answer.** The optimized 3 mm glider features a highly tapered wing with an unswept quarter chord, mounted to the doubled-foam fuselage ahead of the fixed tail surfaces.

```{python}
#| label: fig-three-view
#| fig-cap: "Three-view drawing of the optimized 3 mm foam glider, showing the high-taper wing planform and side profile with the doubled-foam fuselage."
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
axs = fig.subplots(2, 2, subplot_kw={'projection': '3d'})
glider.draw_three_view(axs=axs, show=False)
```
